wire_panels.note: The P12 source ties J17.1 to the shared high-side cutoff-controlled +VFET net; J17.2 is Q19 drain, the Hotend A low-side output. J12.1/.2 are the XT30 VFET power input contacts. J11.1/.2 are the same rails on a small header and must not carry heater current. PE0 -> U9 pin 3/A1 -> U9 pin 17/Y1 -> Q19 gate is the source-derived Hotend A command path. PF14 drives U9 pin19/G2 OUTPUTENABLE; firmware output-enable truth table/startup state has not been verified, so test firmware polarity/state under current-limited load before fitting a heater. The installed MakeICT/Ultimaker heater and sensor identities, voltage/current, connector contacts, J21-to-hotend assignment, fuse and cutoff are unknown; every machine-side route is a guess. The board guide states approx. 5A/output but does not establish J17 connector or harness safe rating; do not treat that number as guaranteed. Internal topology: J12.1 feeds Q25 source pins 1–3; Q25 drain pin5 feeds J17.1 only through the high-side cutoff FET. J17.2 goes to Q19 drain pin5; Q19 source pins1–3 return to GND_FET/J12.2. Do not depict a direct rail wire bypassing Q25 or Q19. MCU U2 C4/PE0 -> U9 pin3/A1 -> U9 pin17/Y1 -> Q19 pin4 gate; U2 P8/PF14 -> U9 pin19/G2. Buffer supply U9 pin20/+5V and pin10/GND are board-internal; firmware enable semantics are unresolved.

wire_panels.note: P12 netlist maps J19 pin 2 to Q21 (FAN1) and J20 pin 2 to Q22 (FAN2); both pin 1 contacts share high-side cutoff-controlled +VFET. Firmware fan-output/channel behavior and actual machine fan assignments are not verified. The source BOM identifies J19/J20 as Molex KK-254 2-pin footprints; this is a component identity, not proof of installed mating contact, wire, PCB copper or safe load rating. For an installed 5V fan, do not connect it to VFET unless the measured rail is 5V and all ratings match; use a correctly specified converter/driver otherwise. Actual switched paths: J12.1 -> Q25 source pins1–3 -> Q25 drain pin5 -> J19/J20 pin1; J19 pin2 -> Q21 drain, Q21 source pins1–3 -> J12.2 GND_FET; J20 pin2 -> Q22 drain, Q22 source pins1–3 -> J12.2. These include the board’s switched devices and do not represent direct wires from J12 to fan terminals.

confirmed_corrections: P12 source resolves exporter-unlabelled output-net placeholders: J17 = Hotend A; J18 = Hotend B; J19 = Fan 1; J20 = Fan 2. Pins 1 share Q25 drain/cutoff-controlled +VFET; pins 2 go respectively Q19/Q20/Q21/Q22 drains (low-side switched outputs).

J11.1=VFET and J11.2=GND_FET are rail distribution contacts, not power-input contacts. Dedicated XT30 rails include J12/J16 (VFET/GND_FET); J12 is used in the panel, and J16 is a parallel equivalent input option. Do not imply heater current should pass through the small J11 header.

Hotend A gate path: MCU U2 C4/PE0 to U9 pin3/A1; U9 pin17/Y1 to Q19 pin4 gate. Shared output enable is MCU U2 P8/PF14 to U9 pin19/G2. Hardware connectivity is confirmed; firmware enable polarity/startup behavior is not.

The board reference guide calls low-current channels approx. 5A, but this does not establish J17/J18 CONN_SFET contact rating, installed mate/wire rating, PCB thermal limits, or a guaranteed safe load. No 5A guarantee should appear.

Temperature connectors J21/J22/J23 have pin 1 analog sensor input and pin 2 GND at the board net level; which connector/channel is mapped to the installed Ultimaker sensor and sensor technology are unknown.
unresolved_gates: Read the exact Prime physical revision marking; this pin/net evidence is P12 2590 only.
Identify installed heater voltage, resistance/current, cable connector and contact rating; install appropriately rated per-channel fuse and independent thermal cutoff before connecting heater power.
Verify whether fitted machine sensor is thermistor, supported PT100 amplifier, thermocouple, or other; establish J21/J22/J23 and firmware channel/type. Unknown sensor must remain open.
Verify VFET supply voltage, current capacity, connector polarity, PE/chassis bond, and current on wiring before connection. Do not power through J11.
Verify configured output names, PE0 control behavior, PF14/U9 output-enable truth table and safe startup state against actual firmware before energizing heater.
Identify installed fan count, voltage, running/startup/stall current and connector contacts. Use J19/J20 only when all limits match; otherwise use a sourced rated external switching stage.
Confirm J17/J18 custom CONN_SFET connector manufacturer/mating contact and current/temperature rating; schematic/BOM does not provide rating.
source_rating_notes: Local official-repository guide docs/hardware/boards/smoothieboard-v2-schematic.md lists approximate current values (Hotend A/B and Fan outputs approx. 5A); treat this as board design guidance, not safe connector/load rating.
Local official-repository docs/hardware/boards/smoothieboard-v2-prime.md likewise says approx. 5A/output and explicitly says verify with specific revision.
P12 BOM: J17/J18 CONN_SFET (no manufacturer part/rating), J19/J20 Molex_KK-254_AE-6410-02A_1x02_P2.54mm_Vertical (no fitted wire/mate evidence).
